```python
from itertools import permutations

riders = ("Reynaldo", "Seamus", "Theresa", "Yuki")
bicycles = ("F", "G", "H", "J")
valid = []

for first in permutations(bicycles):
    d1 = dict(zip(riders, first))
    if d1["Theresa"] != "J":
        continue
    for second in permutations(bicycles):
        d2 = dict(zip(riders, second))
        if any(d1[r] == d2[r] for r in riders):
            continue
        if "F" in (d1["Reynaldo"], d2["Reynaldo"]):
            continue
        if "J" in (d1["Yuki"], d2["Yuki"]):
            continue
        if "H" not in (d1["Theresa"], d2["Theresa"]):
            continue
        if d1["Yuki"] != d2["Seamus"]:
            continue
        valid.append((d1, d2))

predicates = {
    "A": lambda x, y: y["Reynaldo"] == "G",
    "B": lambda x, y: x["Seamus"] == "H",
    "C": lambda x, y: y["Yuki"] == "H",
    "D": lambda x, y: "J" in (x["Seamus"], y["Seamus"]),
    "E": lambda x, y: "G" in (x["Theresa"], y["Theresa"]),
}

possible = []
print("Exhaustive enumeration; valid schedules:", len(valid))
for option, predicate in predicates.items():
    witnesses = [(x, y) for x, y in valid if predicate(x, y)]
    print(option, "satisfying schedules:", len(witnesses))
    if witnesses:
        possible.append(option)
        x, y = witnesses[0]
        print("  Witness day 1:", x)
        print("  Witness day 2:", y)

submitted = "A"
print("Expected possible option(s):", ", ".join(possible) or "none")
print("CHECK PASS" if possible == [submitted] else "CHECK FAIL")
```
